lines.lyric: Naegen an tonghal geol nan nal mideo

lines.lyric_translation: It won’t work on me, I believe in myself

I scream out loud
I’ve been dreaming every day

lines.lyric: Nal shiheom haebwatja nan naaga hangeoreum babe

lines.lyric_translation: You put me to the test but I go one step forward babe

lines.lyric_translation: You try to stop me but I go one step forward babe

It keeps me smiling

lines.lyric_hangul: 저기 닿을 듯한 빛은 꺼지지 않아
lines.lyric_translation: The light I can almost touch will never fade

lines.lyric: Nan eonjena cheongsajin sok gireul channeun geol
lines.lyric_hangul: 난 언제나 청사진 속 길을 찾는 걸
lines.lyric_translation: I’m always looking for my way with the blueprint

lines.lyric: Nan eonjena cheongsajin sok kkumeul kkugon hae
